title: When Does Auxiliary Modality Matter in Solving Geometric Problems? A Comprehensive Study of Textual, Formal, and Visual Modalities

model.params_source: assumed (paper silent on decoding; o4-mini defaults)

task.subset_rule: paper-defined split: Geometry3K test set (601 problems)
task.approximation: three runs instead of the paper's five; the secondary equivalence check uses gemini-2.0-flash-lite if still callable, otherwise o4-mini-2025-04-16 with the same Figure 7 prompt (resolution plan); the hiyouga/geometry3k mirror stores answers as strings that may differ in form from the authors' copy

items.hf_verified: Hub parquet listing: default/train, validation, test (parquet not downloaded: 61 MB with embedded images; column names from the dataset card)

placeholders.image: attach items.images[0] as an image content part before the text (NOT expressible)
placeholders.question: items.problem

prompt.source_location: Appendix, Figure 8 (geometry problem-solving prompt), baseline condition without the CDL / TCDL / DES / IMG segments
prompt.verbatim: full (auxiliary-modality segments omitted for the baseline as the caption specifies)

placeholders_prose.image: the original geometric diagram attached first (Figure 8: 'Prompt begins with the geometric diagram as input')
placeholders_prose.question: items.problem
placeholders_prose.{{your_answer}}: literal doubled braces as printed (Python-format escaping of the boxed answer)

output.postprocess: normalise (strip $, spaces, degree signs, trailing units); exact string match against answer; residual mismatches go to the equivalence judge which answers True/False

metric.name: accuracy
metric.definition: share of the 601 problems whose boxed answer matches the ground truth after normalisation or is judged mathematically equivalent, in percent, averaged over runs
metric.judge: llm:gemini-2.0-flash-lite (substitute o4-mini-2025-04-16 if retired), prompt location Appendix Figure 7 (mathematical equivalence prompt, output True/False)
metric.original_location: Appendix Table 1, Geometry3k block, row Baseline, column GPT-o4-mini 2025-04-16 (mean of five runs)

open_points: Image input: the Geometry3K diagram must be attached to the user message (text-only runner).
Runner defect: the unfilled-slot check rejects the literal '\boxed{your_answer}' of the Figure 8 prompt; a hook render() would bypass it, but the image blocker remains.

Residual mismatches go to an equivalence judge on gemini-2.0-flash-lite (not callable through the battery's OpenAI client; aux model, substitute o4-mini per the resolution plan); the parse must keep the LAST boxed answer.
notes: The CSV tier is high (five runs); with three runs and ~$0.015 per image call the cost is mid. The equivalence-judge calls (mismatches only) are a small extra. || [hook pass 2026-09-07] no hook: image input.
runner_gaps: prompt: literal braces in the rendered text
